verdict.rationale: Shopify documents a Global Catalog that "enables AI agents to search and discover products across the entire Shopify ecosystem". This is a cross-merchant, agent-built catalog exposed through UCP and official MCP servers, and the marketing pages position merchants to "sell in AI chats". All of this is first-party documentation only, with no detail on how a merchant's products get included or how they reach answer engines specifically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that merchant products surface to agents, documentation of merchant-side inclusion/opt-in and feed controls, explicit coverage of answer engines beyond agent-built integrations.
